caption: The drawing depicts a length of thick, twisted brown rope or cord with six short, cylindrical, light tan or yellowish bands attached at intervals along its length. The rope forms an elongated loop with the ends positioned near the top corners of the image, where each end is capped and connected by a short, straight segment of yellowish material that resembles a handle or bar across the top left. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color with some visible flecks and marks, suggesting an aged or textured paper. The composition centers the rope, which drapes down in a symmetrical, U-shaped curve, with the bundled sections connected by the light-colored cylindrical bands distributed evenly along the rope.
title: Necklace
